product: Semaglutide franchise (Ozempic and Wegovy including an oral Wegovy pill), CagriSema (semaglutide plus cagrilintide), next-generation amylin treatments, Sogroya and denecimig FREHEMGO in blood and endocrine, plus a new consumer hair-loss push.
demand: US and global demand for GLP-1 obesity and diabetes drugs remains strong, but Novo's own sales growth is slowing and competition is intensifying, with FY2026 adjusted sales guided to 0% to -6% CER.
pricing_power: Weakening. US price cuts on Ozempic and Wegovy, PBM and formulary leverage, compounded alternatives and the 2032 US semaglutide patent expiry all erode pricing, though BofA called the recent cuts flashy yet not decisive for Lilly.
competition: Eli Lilly leads with tirzepatide and oral orforglipron; Viking Therapeutics, Amgen, Pfizer and Novartis add pressure, while compounded semaglutide and telehealth sellers compete at the edges.
team: CEO Maziar Mike Doustdar, CSO Martin Holst Lange and CFO Karsten Munk Knudsen. 2026 brought a cultural reset and rebrand to Novo after about 13,000 cumulative layoffs, with IR leadership and board changes reported from late 2025.
market_strategy: Diversify beyond obesity and diabetes into blood, endocrine, liver and cardiovascular disease; push oral and long-acting formulations; run a direct-to-consumer playbook; pursue bolt-on M&A; and keep open the option of a direct New York listing upgrade.
bull: Q2 2026 adjusted sales +7% CER and operating profit +11% with raised guidance; Nanexa deal (2026-09-24) adds long-acting dosing; CagriSema beat tirzepatide and FDA decision due Q4 2026.
bear: Shares -19.8% over 63 days; FY2026 guidance 0% to -6% CER; Morgan Stanley cut to Underweight 2026-09-11 on 2032 semaglutide patent cliff; Deutsche Bank Sell, DKK265 target; DKK6.3bn impairments.
falsifier: Q3 2026 results on 2026-11-04 showing adjusted sales growth below 0% CER, or CagriSema FDA rejection in Q4 2026.
web_what_changed: Q2 2026 on 2026-08-04: adjusted sales +7% CER to DKK78488m and adjusted operating profit +11% to DKK33389m, with 2026 outlook raised to 0% to -6% CER. Rebrand to Novo 2026-09-14. Capital Markets Day 2026-09-21 set peer-average growth, over five blockbusters by 2030, about USD23bn obesity sales target, semaglutide US patent 2032; shares fell about 7.7% despite CagriSema beating tirzepatide.
web_not_known_yesterday: On 2026-09-24 Novo licensed Nanexa PharmaShell drug-delivery platform for up to EUR1.165bn (EUR615m upfront plus milestones) across five cardiometabolic programs enabling monthly to quarterly dosing; Nanexa shares rose 114% on 2026-09-25. Novo also said on 2026-09-23 it is open to upgrading to a direct New York listing.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Volume-led: US GLP-1 demand is strong enough that Danmarks Nationalbank doubled Denmark growth forecast on 2026-09-23. Price is the headwind: US Ozempic and Wegovy price cuts, PBM leverage and the semaglutide patent expiry. FY2026 adjusted sales guidance of 0% to -6% CER shows price and mix offsetting volume, with mix shifting toward oral Wegovy pills.
web_suppliers: In-house semaglutide API plus acquired Catalent fill-finish capacity; cartridge manufacturing via Shantha Biologics in India (2026-06-30); drug-delivery licensed from Nanexa (2026-09-24). Manufacturing capacity was the historic constraint, but Novo now targets tenfold production and cut 400 roles at Bloomington (2026-03-31), suggesting pockets of overcapacity.
web_customers: Highly concentrated US channel: the three big wholesalers plus PBMs such as Express Scripts, CVS Caremark and Optum Rx, and national health systems. A changed CVS formulary decision around May-June 2026 was framed as a lost advantage. Florida sued insulin makers and a PBM over pricing on 2026-09-22.
web_who_loses: Eli Lilly loses share if Novo wins, given competing tirzepatide (Zepbound, Mounjaro) and oral orforglipron. Also pressured: Viking Therapeutics, Amgen, Pfizer, Novartis obesity entrants, telehealth resellers such as Hims and Hers, compounding pharmacies (Dutch injunction 2026-08-06) and insulin incumbents.
web_contradicting_evidence: Shares are about -19.8% over 63 days to DKK252.60 and roughly -18% year to date. Morgan Stanley cut to Underweight or Sell on 2026-09-11 citing the semaglutide patent cliff; Deutsche Bank keeps Sell with a DKK265 target; Capital Markets Day targets underwhelmed investors; Q2 carried DKK6.3bn impairments including monlunabant DKK4.0bn; a cardiovascular trial was halted; hundreds of GLP-1 vision-loss lawsuits were filed.
web_if_management_right: CagriSema wins US FDA approval expected Q4 2026, oral Wegovy scales, over five new blockbusters arrive by 2030, pipeline sales exceed USD23bn by 2035, obesity reaches its USD23bn target, pills take about 50% of the weight-loss market by 2030, long-acting Nanexa formulations extend franchises, and Novo re-emerges diversified beyond semaglutide.
web_if_management_wrong: US semaglutide patent loss in 2032, over half of sales, combines with price erosion and share loss to Lilly to compress revenue; overbuilt capacity brings further impairments; growth stays below peers and the multiple stays depressed; GLP-1 litigation and PBM pushback escalate.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: Nanexa as licensed partner (shares +114%), Catalent and contract fill-finish makers, Shantha Biologics, device and packaging suppliers, AI partner Anthropic, the UNICEF partnership, Danish exporters and the Danish economy, and direct-to-consumer and telehealth distributors.
